title: The most of anything
prompt: Return the largest amount in the inventory. The inventory has at least one entry.
hints: Track the biggest value seen so far, starting from 0 or the first value.

docs.name: for key in data:
docs.what: Runs once per key; data[key] gives its value.

docs.name: data[key]
docs.what: The value stored under key. Assigning to it changes or adds the entry.
